scientific_integrity: Analytical proof establishes global monotonicity transition and weak-lag-contrast asymptotic; stand-alone deterministic computations supplement rather than certify infinite claims. Source review has residual priority risk from inaccessible original full texts.
scientific_limitations: Exact for two independent first-order fuel classes sharing a sinusoidal atmospheric-equilibrium moisture signal, constant rates and one fixed absolute dry cutoff; it does not predict ignition, fire spread, stochastic weather, rain, or hysteretic drying. A numerical threshold example is illustrative only.
title: A sharp joint-dryness recovery threshold for two fuel time-lag classes
